verdict: No paid ads are live; organic activity alone is not enough.
narrative: This period ran on zero paid spend across Meta and Google, so the pipeline is drawing entirely from organic sources. Six contacts and three opportunities were recorded in the last 28 days, but none converted to a booked appointment and no pipeline value has been assigned. Several setup milestones — including conversion tracking infrastructure and paid landing pages — are overdue and are being completed now, as these are the direct blockers to relaunching ads. Once those are cleared, paid campaigns will go live and lead volume should rise meaningfully from where it sits today.
